body: BLOCK at exact 9881e06c7211ae5ef5505ab4edc6b1a9b2b852d9. Ancestry, one-path scope, and the five amended source-ownership descriptions are correct. The successor does not cure the governing Code Red content hold post-01M1DVK1WYT003RWS8M8RFXRCH: section 5.1 still smart-constructs from one checked RecallGraph and binds recall units/transcript identity, but no construction policy or receipt is bound; no selected-alternative identity is derived by proving membership in the retained alternative set; no same-content heuristic-versus-admitted falsifier is specified; and no sensitivity court requires separate complete result families with each recall-unit/row basis, forbidding averaged or concatenated P/F across segmentations absent a declared common base measure, projection, and calibration. Required successor: retain the valid source corrections and add those exact construction-authority and uncertainty-preservation courts.
